detaileddescription.para: Computes size from Config proportions, builds search and action rows, configures fonts and colours. Ready to be hosted in a terminal::ModalWindow via Popup::show().

detaileddescription.para: Escape in navigation mode calls onDismiss; in search mode either selects the first visible result or clears the search text.

parameterdescription.para: The key press event to handle.

simplesect.para: True if the key was consumed, false to propagate up.

briefdescription.para: Lays out the search box, viewport, and message overlay within current bounds.
Builds and populates all rows from action::Registry.

detaileddescription.para: Inserts: search row (index 0), global action rows, separator, prefix key row, then modal action rows. Calls layoutRows() on completion.

briefdescription.para: Applies font, colour, and input settings to the search TextEditor.

parameterdescription.para: The TextEditor widget inside the search Row.

briefdescription.para: Applies highlight colour and label colours to an action Row.
Filters visible rows by fuzzy-matching against query.

detaileddescription.para: Empty query restores all rows. Non-empty query hides non-matching rows (separators are always hidden during search). Calls layoutRows() and selectRow(0).

parameterdescription.para: The search string typed in the search box.

briefdescription.para: Recomputes row positions and resizes rowContainer to fit visible rows.
Resolves the target row index, skipping non-selectable or non-visible rows.

detaileddescription.para: Scans in the direction of travel from index. Falls back to 0 (search box) if no valid row is found.

simplesect.para: The resolved selectable, visible row index.

briefdescription.para: Selects the row at index, scrolling into view as needed.

detaileddescription.para: Skips non-selectable or non-visible rows (e.g. separator, filtered-out actions) by stepping in the direction of travel. Clamps to valid range. Grabs keyboard focus when a navigation row is selected.

parameterdescription.para: The target row index to select.

briefdescription.para: Executes the action on the currently selected row.

detaileddescription.para: If row 0 (search) is selected, finds the first visible action row and runs it.

briefdescription.para: Returns the count of visible, selectable rows (excludes search row and separators).

simplesect.para: Number of rows the user can navigate to.

briefdescription.para: Returns the index of the currently selected row.

Returns the row index currently in binding mode, or -1 if none.

parameterdescription.para: Row index to put into binding mode; -1 to clear.

briefdescription.para: Enters binding mode for the currently selected row, if selectable.

detaileddescription.para: Shows the MessageOverlay prompt and stores the row index via setBindingRowIndex().

briefdescription.para: Exits binding mode, hides the MessageOverlay, and restores keyboard focus.
Handles a key press while in binding mode.

detaileddescription.para: Ctrl+C exits binding mode without remapping. Any other key is recorded as the new shortcut for the bound row, patches Config, and rebuilds the key map.

parameterdescription.para: The key press to record or cancel with.

simplesect.para: True if the key was consumed by binding mode.

briefdescription.para: Responds to ValueTree property changes — patches Config and rebuilds key map.

detaileddescription.para: Called by JUCE when any property on the ACTION_LIST tree changes. Compares each action row's current shortcut label against Config; patches any divergence and marks bindingsDirty for Config reload on destruction.

parameterdescription.para: The identifier of the property that changed.

briefdescription.para: Command palette component with fuzzy search and keyboard navigation.

detaileddescription.para: Self-contained: builds rows from the action::Registry on construction, manages selection state, and handles all keyboard input through KeyHandler. Hosted inside a terminal::ModalWindow via Popup::show(). Escape is not consumed — it falls through to the hosting ModalWindow for dismissal. State changes (binding edits, dirty flag) propagate via juce::ValueTree::Listener.
